definitions.short: (only in the dual) a pair of scales

occurrences.englishText: You shall have just balances, just weights, a just ephah,‡ 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel and a just hin.§ A hin is about 6.5 liters or 1.7 gallons. I am Yahweh your God, who brought you out of the land of Egypt.
(let me be weighed in an even balance,
A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh,
Honest balances and scales are Yahweh’s;
Who has measured the waters in the hollow of his hand,
Behold, the nations are like a drop in a bucket,
I signed the deed, sealed it, called witnesses, and weighed the money in the balances to him.

“You, son of man, take a sharp sword. You shall take it as a barber’s razor to yourself, and shall cause it to pass over your head and over your beard. Then take balances to weigh and divide the hair.
“You shall have just balances, a just ephah,† 1 ephah is about 22 liters or about 2/3 of a bushel and a just bath.
